title: On release day an existing customer keeps its one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Before the release was installed, customer {Customer-A} had {Sales-rep-A} as its sales representative and customer {Customer-B} had none, and you noted how both customer pages looked.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Before and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Before None.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • The browser window is a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, and the design pictures "customer-00-b-customer-page.png" (board 2.0), "customer-01-b-customer-dialog-open.png" (board 2.1) and "customer-02-b-new.png" (board 2.2) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative" reads {Sales-rep-A}; the page reads as before.
  • Step 2: one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-A}, with no Service Parts or Part Sales field.
  • Step 3: "Sales Representative" reads "Unassigned" where it used to read "N/A".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-E1, S4-R19, Release day, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The tech plan says about 10 production customers whose representative is no longer a user of the shop will read "Unassigned" after the release (accepted by Product as an FYI). This case follows the PRD; the difference is a question for the product owner.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-E1: “On release day every existing customer has the one "Sales Representative" field, with no Service Parts or Part Sales field, and keeps its one representative, so the customer page and every invoice read exactly as before, except that an empty field reads "Unassigned" instead of "N/A".”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • Release day: “Every existing customer keeps its one sales representative and is not split, so the customer page reads as before (S4-E1). One wording changes: a customer with no representative reads "Unassigned" instead of "N/A" (S4-R19).”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.0 Before: the customer page today; 2.1 Before: Edit Customer today; 2.2 Before: New Customer today ("Before" boards: production today, attached for comparison).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-00-b-customer-page.png, customer-01-b-customer-dialog-open.png, customer-02-b-new.png.
